run_ban_constant_numbers: run the ban_constant_numbers script to scan a Python codebase for disallowed hardcoded numbers
check_file_hardcoded_numbers: check a single Python file for hardcoded numbers not in the allowed set using check_file
review_HardcodedNumberFinder: review the HardcodedNumberFinder AST visitor class that detects disallowed numeric constants in Python source
refactor_ALLOWED_NUMBERS: refactor the ALLOWED_NUMBERS set to add or remove permitted numeric constants for the linter
test_HardcodedNumberFinder_visit_Constan: test the HardcodedNumberFinder visit_Constant method to verify it catches disallowed numbers in Python 3.8+
